title: Triceps Form Sahi Ya Galat? 🤔 Stop This Mistake! ❌ #gym #tricepsworkout  #workoutmistakes  #shorts
description:
Triceps bana rahe ho par growth nahi aa rahi? 😳
Ho sakta hai aap yeh common mistakes kar rahe ho:
❌ Elbow flare karna
❌ Half reps lagana
❌ Heavy weight me form kharab karna
❌ Mind-muscle connection ignore karna
Sahi form + full stretch + controlled reps = Bigger Triceps 💪🔥
Agar aap serious ho apni arm growth ke liye, yeh mistakes aaj hi band karo!
